block.description: The record id of the block that decides it; empty when none is known.

why.description: The reviewer's words when the change is disputed; empty otherwise.

items.description: One place where the code moves a record from one state to another.

transitions.description: Every change of state of the life.

items.description: The life of one kind of data that has states.

lifecycles.description: The lives of the kinds of data that have states.

container.description: The window's class, as the code writes it.

name.description: The control's name as the code writes it.

declaredAs.description: The control's declaration, which gives its kind.

what.description: The routine, as its class and name.

file.description: The file, relative to the source folder.

lastLine.description: The last line of the routine.

unreached.description: The routines nothing the analysis could follow reaches.

description: What a bundle needs beyond the capability and system payloads: the blocks and the links between them, which blocks read or save which data, who reaches each rule and where a second reading left it, the lives of the data, each window's controls and the code nothing reaches.
